review.finding: The back action at step<=1 returns {...INITIAL_STATE}, which resets customProfiles to []. The IntentWizard effect depends only on stackReport (unchanged), so after New -> back -> New the user's own profiles are gone for the session.
review.suggestion: Preserve customProfiles on reset; add a reducer test for pickDoor -> back -> pickDoor.

review.finding: POST /api/stack-profiles/validate passes user-supplied body.name unvalidated into the resolver argv (--name <name>). shell:false rules out shell injection, but a value such as --project-root or -h is parsed by argparse as an option. No length cap or character check, unlike create.
review.suggestion: Reject names failing the shared NAME_RE and length cap with 400, or use --name=<name>.

review.finding: On a transport failure after the write (engine-unavailable, timeout, unsupported-contract) the file is removed but the message says the resolver rejected it; fsp.rm is unguarded so an rm failure throws an unhandled 500.
review.suggestion: Distinguish transport failure from valid:false; wrap rollback rm in try/catch.

review.finding: Name traversal and overwrite properly blocked. The .shipwright/profiles dir has no realpath check (DO-NOT #10); a symlinked dir could redirect the write. Low risk: projectRoot comes from the server registry.
review.suggestion: Optionally realpath the target dir and assert it stays under the project root / user dir.

review.finding: A profile list arriving after step 1 is silently dropped; consistent and safe, a deliberate trade-off.
